g.text: KayaRank4Convo3 begins.

g.title: j3896849617
g.text: I trust you.

g.title: j3816318962
g.text: Doesn't mean I'm sticking around here without an escape option though.

g.title: j1640582692
g.text: I am glad we trust each other now [End.]

g.title: j1565009441
g.text: How close are you to securing your 'escape'?

g.title: j368351563
g.text: What convinced you?

g.title: j465934596
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j1676750572
g.text: Ehhh ask me again tomorrow?

g.title: j416772110
g.text: I know we are wayyy past high school.

g.title: Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank4Convo4.
g.text: Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank4Convo4.

g.title: j465934596->Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank4Convo4.
j688704059
g.text: Could be really close, really onto something.

g.title: j584229424
g.text: But it doesn't take a kid-genius to see that you really care about us. And we all respect you.

g.title: j4293454068
g.text: You're close to escaping 1999?

g.title: j3431245781
g.text: What's the current lead?

g.title: j2702775789
g.text: Even Arthur. Firstly, huge crush on him omg.

g.title: j225126323
g.text: Yup! There are a few caveats of course. The most certain and safe path is to go EXACTLY to when you came from, as there's something of a 'Void Fingerprint' there.

g.title: j3820804377
g.text: You, of course.

g.title: j1211137507
g.text: Check boolean ArthurDating

g.title: j2336293573
g.text: You're still sure about this, then?

g.title: j1254325875
g.text: My time isn't exactly much better, but at least I'm there to help.

g.title: j376993693
g.text: Hmm, the Void is actually kind of serious about fingers.

g.title: j1629196214
g.text: I must be special.

g.title: j4082395978
g.text: Me?

g.title: j1368453696
g.text: You know he's taken, right?

g.title: j1211137507->j1368453696
g.text: true

g.title: j3814550325
g.text: I'll put in a good word.

g.title: j1211137507->j3814550325
g.text: false

g.title: j55323372
g.text: Gross.

g.title: j1211137507->j55323372
g.text: false

g.title: j3236301688
g.text: So sure. It's a challenge. Whatever happens happens, right? Like, it's keeping me busy, focused...

g.title: j3982534318
g.text: Exactly! Burn the ships! No looking back!

g.title: j2990222349
g.text: Huh?

g.title: j1251668719
g.text: Pfft I know, LUCKY! Anywayyyy

g.title: j1606653847
g.text: PFFT NO please don't I told you that in CONFIDENCE! Anyway...

g.title: j192628177
g.text: Um, are you crazy? Not Gross. ANYWAY!

g.title: j1411638823
g.text: There's no downside. Either I figure it out, or I don't. See ya here, or see ya there. Right? See ya!

g.title: j3178235360
g.text: All of this, everything Entrati did. His pursuit of the Void, the essence of... it all.

g.title: j537645247
g.text: But in a way this is like highschool where, like, everyone likes you.

g.title: j3675732419
g.text: Comes down to 1 finger. A finger.

g.title: j2753221283
g.text: And that says something deeper than just popularity.

g.title: j4064098792
g.text: Did you get into Arthur's beers? Why didn't you mention this sooner?

g.title: j3730498848
g.text: We're all kind of super messed up.

g.title: j3181636469
g.text: The Void. Textbooks don't help much on that subject.

g.title: j495696745
g.text: A beer would probably help things make sense.

g.title: j2414257767
g.text: It's not something that just gets 'mentioned'. It is the end and the beginning.

g.title: j2204956600
g.text: Messed up and busy! Welcome to the team [End.]

g.title: j2827041910
g.text: Who do you think is the most messed up?

g.title: j1662890440
g.text: Is that a compliment?

g.title: j93487193
g.text: But what do you mean a finger?

g.title: j1438474859
g.text: Omg... gossiping? After what I just said?

g.title: j1071343027
g.text: It totally is. 100 percent. Because no one here is competing.

g.title: j3248886712
g.text: Albrecht has its finger.

g.title: j2612354949
g.text: There is a finger from... it. In my time. Our world, I guess.

g.title: j1429655416
g.text: (But obviously Arthur because I was talking to him and it sounds like you really messed with his head).

g.title: j169373536
g.text: It's just like, the weirdest thing. We're turning into monsters but it's the most human I've ever felt.

g.title: j1799664350
g.text: Ok so matter is retained, thanks!

g.title: j2463769001
g.text: Which, incidentally, confirmed a hypothesis I had about your corporeal connection to 1999.

g.title: j2852234599
g.text: I can actually be myself now.

g.title: j4176236229
g.text: That's it?

g.title: j1165821689
g.text: Which is relevant because.. ah! Test done. Talk soon.

g.title: j1412707284
g.text: I'm not afraid anymore.

g.title: j3648151955
g.text: Not 'what is it'? Why does it have a finger?

g.title: j3155889822
g.text: So, thanks?

g.title: j1775555913
g.text: You can deal with that. States of matter preservation are more interesting. Thanks!
